content.text: The insurance provisions meet the preferred position in full, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: § 18.1 obligates Vendor (Copperleaf) to carry, at its own expense for the term plus one year, CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M — matching the preferred position line by line, with employer's liability of USD 1M as additional cover in our favour. § 18.2 adds certificates and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primary-coverage and cancellation-notice undertakings, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, so the cap/liability interaction is preserved. All obligations run against the counterparty and benefit us; nothing requires amendment.
